PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan for Asthma-Friendly Progression"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "progress toward 5K in 12 weeks with warmup-driven asthma safety"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & warmup prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jogging 0 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Breath control & basics":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          running 1x5..7 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Low impact build":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 1x8..10 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x5..7 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Breath efficiency":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 1x8..9 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Interval intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x2..3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Tempo prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Breath pacing":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x5..7 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Smooth easy miles":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Mixed run/walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x5..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Breath control & form":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Progress check":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x3..5 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Consistency & volume":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x6..9 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Breath efficiency":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Longer easy pace":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x12..14 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Progression with pace":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x6..9 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Breath control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Cumulative distance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x14..18 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Threshold prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x7..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pace consistency":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Long easy":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x16..20 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Mix & match":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 4x8..11 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Breath focus & form":
        warmup:

          run 2x6..9 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Tempo introduction":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 65m "Long run progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x20..24 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Steady build":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mini tempo":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 70m "Longer run":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x22..26 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Race prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Tapering intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Light assessment":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run_walk 2x14..18 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Final tune-up":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x6..8 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Sharpening pace":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x5..7 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday testing 30m "5K readiness test":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x5K rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names)
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES (use ONLY these names for warmups, cooldowns, and cardio sessions)
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes:
- This plan prioritizes asthma safety with stepwise progression, longer warmups, and controlled pace. Use SABA as prescribed if needed before sessions. If wheeze or chest tightness occurs, pause, use inhaler, and repeat later or substitute with walking until symptoms resolve.
- If outdoor cold-air exposure is planned, consider an indoor alternative (walking or treadmill jogging) for weeks 1–4 and gradually reintroduce outdoor sessions in Phase 2 with temperature-appropriate warmups.
